<solar/>Scorch and <solar/>Ignitions that originate from this weapon deal 15% increased damage.

Holding down the trigger for 0.45 seconds creates a focused 'Solar Field' that continuously expands from the point of impact. 

The radius grows up to 4? meters wide over the course of 4 seconds, dealing <pve 19 /> <pvp [6] /> damage every 0.1 seconds to all enemies within it.

Scoring 20 hits within 1.5 seconds of each with this weapon's beam or Solar Field applies 20 <solar/>Scorch stacks (30 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes).
